60153:
Everyday life gets a cozy twist with the laid-back Rilakkuma. Gentle moments of friendship, change, and small joys unfold, turning ordinary moments into something quietly magical—one soft, comforting day at a time.

It's a moment that will make your heart feel lighter and lighter. No matter where you are or what you're doing, Rilakkuma will be by your side. An exciting new story begins! Experience the stress-free world of Rilakkuma, the relaxed bear who makes being lazy look effortless!
(Source: Crunchyroll, Rilakkuma Anime Site, translated)
64710:
The supreme prince of the Spirit Realm was tragically murdered after being plotted against, and reborn into the mortal world as a lowly servant! Possessing an unparalleled creation elixir and heaven-defying cultivation techniques, he overturns the entire martial arts world with only a rusty sword.

His dual martial souls awaken simultaneously, refining all spirits and comprehending the dual paths of divine soul cultivation. He traverses the Heavenly Demon Treasury, the Dragon Transformation Realm, and ancient ruins, acquiring supreme treasures such as the Demon Lord Armor and the Great Desolate Mirror.

Various prodigies, sect parasites, and extraterrestrial evil races come to his death, but he crushes them all with a single sword strike! He subdues a dragon soul and a spirit dog, protects his beloved friends and family, surpasses Martial Kings, breaks through Martial Emperors, and ascends to Martial Venerable status. He confronts his two archenemies, Long Zhetian and Nangong Lingtian, tearing apart the long-buried conspiracy of ancient dark turmoil.(Source: iQIYI, translated)
61897:
Beryl Gardenant, a swordmaster from the countryside, is settling into his new life as a special instructor for the Royal Order of Knights and the guardian of an orphan. A peaceful life is not in the cards, however, and Beryl is confronted with new obstacles. At the magic institute, in his hometown, at the kingdom's border, away in a foreign land... It's time for Beryl to face new battles.

(Source: Prime Video)
63418:
Three ordinary schoolboys come into possession of a DVD that supposedly opens a gateway to a parallel universe, but when their backs are turned Pyontaro's little sister Futaba passes through and gets kidnapped by the aliens that have overrun that version of Earth! Discovering that their cartoonish bodies make them supermen in the hyper-realistic parallel universe, the boys set out to rescue Futaba.

(Source: Kodansha USA)
64577:
The second season of Youjo Shenki.

Chibi parody of Youjo Senki.
62954:
Gu Feiyang, the third strongest warrior on the Tianwu Continent and the Martial Emperor Pojun, was bound by the world's rules, his cultivation stuck at the Nine Heavens Martial Emperor realm for many years, unable to break through. To escape this predicament, he used the affections of Qu Hongyan, the mistress of the Shenxiao Palace, to orchestrate a grand scheme, sacrificing extraterrestrial demonic energy to reincarnate and cultivate anew.

In his reincarnation, he was named Li Yunxiao, a 15-year-old boy from the Tianshui Kingdom and the eldest grandson of the Li family of the Marshal's Mansion. At this time, Tianshui was beset by powerful enemies invading from the outside and princes vying for the throne from within, making the Li family, who held military power, the center of a vortex of crisis. Faced with the power struggles of everyone, Li Yunxiao stood at a higher level, calmly breaking through the impasse. He deeply understood that in this world where martial arts reign supreme, all power ultimately came from within, and his goal remained singular: to complete the scheme laid out in his previous life and build a foundation for the Divine Realm.
63047:
When the seal of the Demon Realm shatters, demon soldiers surge into the Human World, tearing through everything in their path. Five young warriors rise to meet the invasion, summoning their legendary armor and charging headfirst into battle. With every clash, they cut through the invading demon hordes, unleashing their power to drive the invasion back. They are…the Samurai Troopers!

(Source: Crunchyroll)
54919:
Two loose and cute cats, Riri and Popo, go on short animated adventures based on “enriching everyday life with everyone’s geek activities and promotions.” Riri is a "menhera" (mentally unstable) cat not blessed by the idol she supports while Popo is an airheaded cat who is cute in a devilish way. Otakuchanzu is the first anime to be originally created for TikTok.

(Source: Anime News Network & Official YouTube Channel)
